title: Catalog
description: The hand-maintained list of API-hosted model offerings that candidates are drawn from (CAT-1). Edited by pull request. CI fails if any offering is missing its as_of date or source_url (CAT-2). No retirement dates or lifecycle tracking in the MVP. Uniqueness of (provider, model) cannot be expressed in JSON Schema, so the loader checks it.

provider.description: Lowercase provider key, the same value used in records and in the partner's provider allow-list, e.g. openai, anthropic, gemini.

model.description: Model id as the provider's API expects it.

context_window.description: Maximum tokens the model accepts across input and output.

tool_support.description: Whether the model supports tool/function calling. Stage 1 drops offerings without it when the traffic uses tools.

regions.description: Regions where the provider can process requests for this model, as lowercase identifiers such as us or eu. Stage 1 drops offerings that cannot serve a required region.

as_of.description: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) the context window, regions and prices were last checked against source_url. Required. The report shows it, and the weekly review keeps it fresh. A pattern rather than format: date, so the generated model and the schema enforce exactly the same thing; the loader also rejects impossible dates such as 2026-02-30.

source_url.description: Link to the provider page the figures came from. Must be https. Required, so a reviewer can verify them.

Region.description: A lowercase region identifier such as us or eu.

Prices.description: List prices in US dollars per one million tokens.

cached_input.description: Price for input tokens served from the provider's prompt cache, if it has one.
